description: Engine §10: error-free and ending-after must hold on the same witness in either order.

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage before
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $a:A $b:bad
%emits $a :: X, $b :: X
%rule bad A
%error "bad"
%stage last
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text X X
%conditions ¬$.parse(r …).error-free.ending-after($.first-token), ¬$.parse(r …).ending-after($.first-token).error-free, Long ⊆ $.parse(r …).ending-after($.first-token).tags, Short ⊆ $.parse(r …).error-free.tags
%rule r
 | X :: Short
 | X X :: Long
```
